questions.question: On this day in 1793, which former Queen of France was put on trial and convicted of treason?
questions.explanation: On this day in 1793, Marie Antoinette was tried and found guilty of treason before her execution.
questions.context:
On this day in 1793: Queen Marie Antoinette of France is tried and convicted of treason.
Marie Antoinette (Queen of France from 1774 to 1792): Marie Antoinette was Queen of France as the wife of Louis XVI from 10 May 1774 until the abolition of the French monarchy in 1792 during the French Revolution.

questions.question: Which actress played roles in Cruel Intentions, Legally Blonde, and the Hellboy film series?
questions.explanation: Selma Blair is recognised for her appearances in hit films such as Cruel Intentions, Legally Blonde, and Hellboy.
questions.context: Selma Blair (American actress (born 1972)): Selma Blair is an American actress. She is known for her roles in Cruel Intentions, Legally Blonde, The Sweetest Thing, and the Hellboy franchise.

questions.question: Which television presenter hosted the E4 reality spin-off series Big Brother's Big Mouth?
questions.explanation: Russell Brand initially gained widespread fame in the United Kingdom hosting Big Brother's Big Mouth on E4.
questions.context: Russell Brand (English comedian, actor, and podcaster (born 1975)): Russell Edward Brand is an English comedian, actor, podcaster, and media personality. He initially was a stand-up comedian and radio and television presenter in the UK, where he received public attention for being the host of the television show Big Brother's Big Mouth, which was a spin-off from the reality show Big Brother, broadcast on E4.

questions.question: Which boxer held the title of undisputed world heavyweight champion from 1987 until 1990?
questions.explanation: Mike Tyson dominated the heavyweight division as its undisputed champion between 1987 and 1990.
questions.context: Mike Tyson (American boxer and media personality (born 1966)): Michael Gerard Tyson is an American former professional boxer who competed between 1985 and 2024. Nicknamed "Iron Mike" and "Kid Dynamite" in his early career, and later known as "the Baddest Man on the Planet", Tyson is widely regarded as one of the greatest heavyweight boxers of all time, and one of the most intimidating men in boxing history. He reigned as the undisputed world heavyweight champion from 1987 to 1990.

questions.question: In legislative assemblies following the Westminster system, what term is used for insults or accusations of dishonesty that breach speaking standards?
questions.explanation: In Westminster parliaments, improper speech such as profanities or claims that another member is lying is known as unparliamentary language.
questions.context:
Unparliamentary language (Words that offend the dignity of an assembly): 

Parliaments and legislative bodies around the world impose certain rules and standards during debates. Tradition has evolved that there are words or phrases that are deemed inappropriate for use in the legislature whilst it is in session. 
In a Westminster system, this is called unparliamentary language and there are similar rules in some but not all other legislative systems. This includes, but is not limited to, the suggestion of dishonesty or the use of profanity.
